QuestInfo.name: [Orange Mushroom] On the Mushking Empire
QuestInfo.0: The Scholarly 'Shroom failed to make a love connection. Comfort him and to see what you need to do next.
QuestInfo.1: Collect information from the mushrooms of the Mushking Empire.
QuestInfo.2: You couldn't get much more information on the Mushking Empire. Talk to the Scholarly 'Shroom about what you did get.

1.msg: You mean how after your incredible jump, Julietta still ignores you?

2.msg: Yes. That. Never speak of that again. Let's just move on to the next hypothesis.

3.msg: Are you familiar with the Mushking Empire? The mushrooms there are quite intelligent, almost as much as I. There's a chance they know something that I don't.

4.msg: Can you pay them a visit and get ask around?\r\n#r<< Accept to be moved to that map. >>

yes.0: I'm not sure you can bother the king with a matter like this. Maybe the guardsmen have heard a thing or two.
yes.1: Ask those guardsmen if they've heard anything. I'll tell you where they are. Let's go!

no.0: Guess you're not ready. I know you have something big to do. Take a break and come back when you can.

1.0: Have you gathered enough information from the Mushking Empire?

yes.0: Not much at the Mushking Empire... but those suspicious 'shrooms with the masks...
yes.1: I heard some of the 'shrooms were taking a tough stance to protect their secrets. One of them sent me an... unsettling letter.
yes.2: They're not the most organized group though, so I'm sure we have nothing to worry about. We'll just have to keep an eye out. For now I must talk to the Jumping 'Shroom.
yes.3: Tell me when you are ready, and I'll send you to the Jumping 'Shroom.

default.0: Talk to the mushrooms there. If you want to go back to the castle, #rforfeit the quest#k and talk to me again.
